Gemini Image Prompt — Barreleye Fish

Make the transparent cranial dome unmistakable: outline the dome and its internal anatomical relationship with one extremely restrained abyssal-cyan accent, while all other forms use soft carbon-black monoline contours, rounded joins, flat bone-white fills, cool graphite-gray micro-accents, minimal interior detail, and sparse hatching only where depth is essential. Preserve biologically grounded barreleye anatomy, readable silhouette, calm non-horror expression, sparse plankton/bubble/current marks, smooth matte off-white paper with extremely light natural tooth, flat diffuse illustrative lighting, and the recurring thin hand-drawn outer contour with playful interruptions from tiny ocean marks. Use the full illustration height naturally; do not create a caption reserve, blank strip, empty panel, or low-detail subtitle band. The style_reference defines the approved medium, contour discipline, palette, texture, and educational illustration mood; the world_keyframe defines continuity of frame language, paper field, ocean-mark vocabulary, scale rhythm, and lighting across the creature world; the operator_style_reference is a quality/style anchor for crisp linework, high-key ground, interlocking readability, and editorial clarity only—do not copy its people, objects, logos, pose, layout, or composition. No photorealism, 3D CGI, anime, painterly effects, watercolor, halftones, collage, heavy gradients, dense crosshatching, neon palette, grotesque horror, decorative typography, labels, captions, letters, numbers, or readable text. Exactly one image only; no storyboard, grid, collage, split screen, or panels. NON-NEGOTIABLE EPISODE FRAME CONTRACT: Preserve this recurring frame language in this image: a consistent clean off-white matte field bounded by a thin hand-drawn black contour near the outer edge, occasionally interrupted by tiny bubble, current, or plankton marks; each scene sits inside an organically interlocking line-art illustration window rather than a rigid panel, with generous white breathing channels separating creature silhouettes. The same thin contour weight, rounded corners, scattered miniature ocean marks, and open negative-space rhythm repeat across every body image. The lower edge transitions naturally into a quieter low-detail field rather than a hard caption box.. Preserve its material/edge grammar, texture, palette and inner illustration window while changing only the scene inside it. Do not reserve a lower caption field, blank strip, empty panel or low-detail band. Continue the scene and its natural texture through the full usable height, guided by the previous accepted image, without adding text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, words or UI.
